newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - LTX Corp estimate raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - LTX Corp estimate raised.

text.p: -- Gruntal & Co said Friday it raised its fiscal 1997 earnings estimate for LTX Corp to $0.12, excluding charges, from $0.05 to reflect the company's improved profitability.

-- Gruntal said LTX made strong improvements in its cost structure and substantial strides in bolstering its balance sheet, reporting second-quarter earnings for fiscal 1997 of $0.01 a share versus $0.23 a year ago.
-- The figure exceeded Gruntal's estimate of a loss of $0.05 and a consensus expected loss of $0.04, Gruntal said.
-- LTX designs and manufactures computer-controlled systems used to test semiconductors.
-- Its shares were trading down 3/16 Friday at 6-3/8.
